sourceFile: 08. TIU L5S3-01 - Report test material C-MG difference color - 2nd - date 2026.04.24_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Comparable validation report exists, but the draft misextracts key NG-rate outcomes and includes a spurious aggregate metric.
issues: AI/NG outcome values omit total NG and total rate shown in rows.
Measurement-2 is an aggregate/header-derived statistic, not a condition outcome.
Changed factor should state Baotou C-MG color-NG lots versus Normal Ruijin more clearly.
Tension sample count is likely 8, not 1, despite eight values per row.
Several cited evidence rows are not shown in context, limiting row-level verification.
correctionPlan: Rebuild AI/NG metric using the table header and total NG/rate columns for each condition.
Remove Measurement-2 aggregate statistics from the review case.
Clarify baseline as Normal Ruijin and tested conditions as Baotou C-MG Level 1/2/3/Improve lots.
Correct tension sample count and keep Fail/Pass judgement per row.
Include table header rows and all cited comparison rows in evidence context.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations are partly sufficient, but missing header/context rows and incorrect extraction prevent approval.
